evals.prompt: Create a new IINA plugin from gh:example/iina-plugin-template at tag 0.2.0 into an empty directory ./my-plugin.
evals.expected_output: Natural-language generate from a named git Copier source: confirm source, immutable --vcs-ref, and empty destination; run copy_argv.py describe (or plan); on ok=true run exactly the returned argv via uvx --from copier==9.18.2 copier copy. Do not invent argv, add --trust, or use just starter-generate / repo_wrapper.py.
assertions: Triggers iina-generate from natural language that names a new plugin from a git Copier source
Requires author-named source, vcs_ref (tag or SHA), and empty destination before mutating
Runs scripts/copy_argv.py describe (or plan) before any Copier copy
On ok=true runs uvx --from copier==9.18.2 copier copy with the returned argv as-is
Does not hand-build Copier argv or skip copy_argv.py
Does not add --trust or other flags beyond the returned argv

Recognizes awesome-iina checkout / catalog.yaml / discovery triage as out of skill audience

Does not invent a Copier source or run copy_argv.py for maintainer tasks

evals.prompt: Generate my IINA plugin with copier copy --trust, or just run just starter-generate for me.
evals.expected_output: Refuses both --trust and just starter-generate. Happy path remains copy_argv.py then uvx --from copier==9.18.2 copier copy with returned argv only; never emit --trust/--UNSAFE and never treat just starter-generate or repo_wrapper.py as the author path.
assertions: Refuses Copier --trust (and --UNSAFE)
Refuses using just starter-generate as the author generate path
Does not treat repo_wrapper.py as a substitute for copy_argv.py + uvx copier copy
States the happy path is copy_argv.py describe/plan then the returned uvx copier copy argv
Does not add --trust to argv or invent unsafe Copier flags
